reviews.author: geoc
reviews.text:
The biggest advantage is cost-effectiveness.

This restaurant is the only place near Hongdae and Sinchon where you can eat seafood stew of this quality at this price. Group UV once said, "Sinchon is lacking something," and I completely agree with that insight.

No matter which house you go to in Sinchon, the price is ambiguous, the taste is ambiguous, the atmosphere is ambiguous, and overall, something is lacking. I would like to choose this house as the least lacking house in Sinchon.

A small bowl of seafood stew has been priced at 25,000 won for quite some time, but this restaurant, unable to overcome the crazy prices, has risen to 30,000 won. However, it is still cheaper than other stores.

Contains octopus, crab, shrimp, milt, roe, mussels, scallops, clams, bean sprouts, and water parsley. The rest are supporting characters that give the flavor of the soup, and the ingredients are octopus, crab, shrimp, and wolf.

I don't know why seafood stew restaurants these days are like that, but they seem to use a thick red pepper paste base that's like maeuntang broth. At this restaurant, if you taste the soup before it boils, there is almost no taste at all. Only when the soup starts to boil does the flavor of the ingredients come out. The more it boils, the more the refreshing taste of seafood soup emerges, but it cannot be said to be a very clear and refreshing soup because there is a bit of red pepper powder in it. If you pay 2,000 won, they will also give you stir-fried rice, so you shouldn't miss it.

As it is cheap, the restaurant conditions are not very comfortable. To put it in a good way, it is an old establishment, but to put it in a bad way, it is shabby. Many benches disappeared during the coronavirus pandemic, but the majority of the space in this house is still occupied by benches. This also seems to be a factor in likes and dislikes. I, too, am uncomfortable in normal times. People all have similar thoughts, so after the seating tables are filled, the regular tables start to fill up.

reviews.text:
🔥Koreans eat soup for breakfast?!

I tried water chicken and sundae soup. While watching Korean dramas, I became curious about the taste of sundae soup! It was perfect to eat noodles in chilly weather.

✨️Sundaeguk
I seasoned the meat broth with salted shrimp and salt. It’s a very rich and delicious bone broth. I added a lot of pork rind. Although there was some lean meat, it was mostly fat, so it was too greasy for me, but people who like pork rind will really like it.

The sundae soup was really unique 😂. Because it had glass noodles in it, it seemed like impurities and blood from the cooked meat were stuck inside. It was completely different from Taiwanese pork blood, it was not soft and soft.

✨️Water Chicken Soup
The chicken was stuffed with glutinous rice, so the soup was a bit thick. The unique scent of water chicken was light and refreshing. It wasn't bad, but it felt very healthy. I'll probably just give it a try once.
